meta.title: Pricing — Forcelis plans for businesses and advisors
meta.description: Monthly plans in Mexican pesos, before VAT: Individual for your own company and 10 to 100-company plans for advisors. Services sold separately.

hero.title: Clear plans, from a single company.
hero.subtitle: Monthly prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT. You pay for the companies you analyze, not per user. You don't need a call to find out what it costs.

platform.title: Monthly plans
platform.extra: Each company beyond the included ones: {price} per month. The Individual plan does not take extra companies.
platform.fairUse: Fair use: up to {n} CFDI per company per month.

individual.name: Individual
individual.for: A founder with their own company
individual.summary: See your own company every month through the CFDI you already issue and receive.

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.summary: Up to 10 companies, with reports and dashboards under your own brand.

despacho.name: Practice
despacho.summary: Up to 40 companies for a practice's client list, under your brand.

firma.name: Firm
firma.summary: Up to 100 companies for large practices and consultancies, under your brand.

volumen.name: Volume
volumen.for: A company or account with an enormous number of CFDI
volumen.summary: For client lists above 100 companies or unusually high CFDI volumes.

diagnostics.title: One-off, fixed price

esencial.name: Essential Diagnostic
esencial.asks: 24 months of CFDI — issued, received and payment complements
esencial.gives: Business Score, a six-section report and a 60-minute session

completo.name: Complete Diagnostic
completo.asks: Everything in the Essential, plus trial balance or ledger, inventory, and sales by customer and product
completo.gives: Everything in the Essential, plus operational and inventory analysis

asesores.name: Diagnostic for advisors
asesores.gives: A report under the advisor's brand, to resell

diagnostics.credit: If you take Monitoring within the next 30 days, we credit you 50% of the diagnostic.
diagnostics.monthsNote: Twenty-four months, because the Business Score compares the last 12 against the 12 before them. With less than 24 months, the trend indicators are reported as unavailable.

monitoring.name: Monthly Monitoring
monitoring.includes: A dashboard and a management report every month, plus a 60-minute quarterly review.

founders.title: The first {n} advisors pay half for {months} months.
founders.body: They also get a kick-off session. In exchange, they give us feedback every month, a testimonial, and their clients' authorization for the anonymous benchmark.
founders.note: The discount is temporary: after the {months} months you pay the plan's regular price. No client's data enters the benchmark without that client's signed authorization. Places are limited and we answer in order of arrival.

tax: Prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

closing.title: Not sure which one is yours?
closing.body: Tell us how many companies you serve and what you want to answer. We will say which plan fits, or whether none does.

items.title: For your business
items.body: The Individual plan: one company, your own, using the CFDI you already issue and receive.

items.title: For advisors
items.body: Professional, Practice and Firm put your brand on the deliverables. They differ in how many companies the monthly fee includes.

items.title: Services, separately
items.body: The Diagnostic and Monitoring are delivered by the Forcelis team. They are not part of any plan.

business.title: One company, every month.
business.intro: For owners and management teams who want to see their own company through the CFDI they already issue and receive.
business.accountant: Already have an accountant? If they use Forcelis, you can get your reports through them.

advisors.title: Choose by how many companies you serve.
advisors.intro: All three plans deliver your reports and dashboards under your brand. What changes is capacity: how many companies the monthly fee covers.
advisors.calculator: Work out your margin with your client list
advisors.volumeTitle: More than 100 companies, or a very high CFDI volume?
advisors.volumeBody: The Volume plan is quoted based on your client list and document volume.

shared.title: What stays the same across plans
items: You pay for the companies you analyze, not per user.
Prices in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

card.noBrand: For your own company, no advisor branding
card.fairUse: Up to {n} CFDI per company per month
card.customTerms: Capacity and terms to be agreed

services.title: Separate from the subscription, if you want human judgment.
services.intro: They are not part of any plan and you don't need them to use the platform. The Forcelis team delivers them, and they are contracted separately.

items.q: How do I sign up for a plan?
items.a: Sign-up is not online yet. You choose the plan on this page, send us the request, and a person replies with the steps to activate your account.

items.q: Do I need a demo before signing up?
items.a: No. Prices and what each plan includes are on this page. If you want to see the product first, you can request a demo; how long it takes depends on the type of client.

items.q: What if I serve more companies than my plan includes?
items.a: Each additional company is added to your monthly fee: {price} per month per company. The Individual plan does not take additional companies.
No. You pay for the companies you analyze.
No. Prices are in Mexican pesos, before VAT.

items.q: Are the Diagnostic or Monitoring included in a plan?
items.a: No. They are professional services contracted separately. The platform works without them.
